nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy for sustainable transportation|Cycling and pedestrian-friendly infrastructure_qna_000
nodes.question: How does increased physical activity from changes in transportation infrastructure affect communities?
nodes.answer: Increased physical activity from changes in transportation infrastructure can have positive health impacts on communities by encouraging active modes of transportation such as walking and cycling, leading to improved cardiovascular health and overall well-being.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy for sustainable transportation|Cycling and pedestrian-friendly infrastructure_qna_001
nodes.question: What are the potential benefits of pop-up cycling infrastructure as a niche innovation for sustainable transportation in European cities?
nodes.answer: Pop-up cycling infrastructure can provide a flexible and cost-effective solution to promote sustainable transportation in European cities.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy for sustainable transportation|Cycling and pedestrian-friendly infrastructure_qna_002
nodes.question: How can urban design contribute to creating more walkable and bike-friendly cities?
nodes.answer: Urban design can contribute to creating more walkable and bike-friendly cities by designing streets and public spaces that prioritize pedestrians and cyclists, providing dedicated bike lanes and pedestrian infrastructure, and designing neighbourhoods with amenities within walking or biking distance.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy for sustainable transportation|Cycling and pedestrian-friendly infrastructure_qna_003
nodes.question: What mechanisms can be put in place to encourage active mobility, such as walking and biking, in suburban areas?
nodes.answer: Implementing infrastructure improvements like dedicated bike lanes and pedestrian-friendly pathways can make active mobility a more attractive and safe option for residents in suburban areas. Additionally, providing incentives such as bike-sharing programs can further promote this mode of transport.
